description:
Slycan 27.5'' Adult Mountain Bike

Aluminum Frame - Lightweight, sturdy, durable and more speedy.
Hydraulic Disc Brakes - React more quickly to fully guarantee riding safety.

Lockable Suspension Fork - Smoother and more efficient for all terrain.
Professional 21-Speed Drivetrain - Provides a wide range of gearing, especially for big hill.

High-Quality Frame

Slycan has a high-quality ultralight aluminum frame for riding and moving with ease, corrosion resistant and very easy to clean and maintain. Internal shift cable and brake hose routing can help your cables last longer by protecting them from any environment, reduce wind resistance for higher speed.

Seat is widened, thickened, non-slip and breathable, fully ensure comfort and stability. Absorb shocks on bumpy roads, make you have a longer and more comfortable ride.

Reliable Security

Dual powerful hydraulic disc brakes are more efficient than other brakes, provide you better durability and stopping power for your rugged and damp adventures.

27.5 * 2.1" all terrain tires are lighter, thinner and roll faster to through trails, make riding effortless and non-slip, handle pavement, gravel and dirt with ease. High profile double wall aluminum rims are light and strong, able to withstand the bumps of cross-country.

More Efficient Riding

Front suspension fork with adjustable damping absorbs any bumps and dips on the trail for a smoother-feeling ride. When riding on smooth road, locked suspension means your fork remains inactive, won’t absorb your pedaling power to increase pedaling efficiency.

Therefore, it saves rider's energy and increase speed, allowing ride efficiently and effortlessly over varied terrain.

Professional Drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed derailleur not only means precise, wide, fast shifting when up and down hill, but also bring you a faster speed.

7-speed flywheel has a smaller wheel gear to drive the wheel to turn faster.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, free pedals and assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. Please don’t assemble the fork BACKWARDS. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

XC Tire

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials. It has strong grip and puncture resistance.
Dual-wall rims allow them to withstand high-intensity riding and protect the inner tube from rupture.

Lock-out Suspension Fork

Lockable suspension fork for efficient and save power riding on flat roads.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes

Dual powerful hydraulic disc brakes are more efficient than mechanical disc brakes. It provides you better durability and stopping power for your most rugged adventures.

Shimano 3*7 Speed Drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain allows you to find the place that’s most efficient for you and the higher gear to pursue speed within a wide range of variability.

Master the trails with the Hiland Slycan Mountain Bike. Featuring a lightweight aluminum frame, 27.5/29-inch wheels, a 21-speed Shimano drivetrain, and a lockout suspension fork for peak off-road performance.
